_documentation.description: Static product data for the snacks and namkeen product catalog

structure.name: Display name of the product (string)
structure.description: Detailed description shown in product modal (string)
structure.comingSoon: Boolean flag to indicate if product is coming soon (boolean)

notes: All prices are in Indian Rupees (₹)
Image paths should be relative to the public directory
Products with comingSoon: true will appear in the Coming Soon section
Categories must match the filter options in the UI
